items.title: Has Microsoft Stock Run Ahead Of Its AI Payoff?
items.summary: The software giant's stock has a powerful business engine behind its long-term trend, but a rapid run-up back toward all-time highs forces investors to ask if the price of admission is still worth paying.

items.title: How Much Upside Can AAPL Stock's Growth Deliver?
items.summary: At $314.58, Apple (AAPL) looks set up for roughly 38% of upside over the next three years under a conservative scenario. Not a moonshot, but enough to matter if the math holds. Revenue compounding does all the work, because the scenario holds the multiple flat at today's level rather than assuming any re-rating. Here is the operational reality the math is built on.

items.title: Can PLTR Stock Live Up To Its Multiple?

items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: PayPal, Marvell, Gap, Amazon
items.summary: ↘️ Marvell Technology (MRVL): The semiconductor company reported higher revenue and earnings and lifted its guidance. Still, shares sank 10%, the latest example of the high expectations that investors have for companies tied to the artificial-intelligence boom.

items.title: Costco Stock's Premium Rests On A Visit Rate That Keeps Slowing
items.summary: The comp still looks strong, but the part of it that comes from members actually walking in has more than halved in a year, and that visit rate is what a growth-stock multiple on a warehouse retailer is really underwriting.
